back.bm: Spesifik, boleh diukur, boleh dicapai, realistik, tempoh masa

back.en: Short: under 1 year. Long: more than 5 years
back.bm: Pendek: kurang 1 tahun. Panjang: lebih 5 tahun

back.en: Earned by working: salary, wages, commission
back.bm: Diperoleh dengan bekerja: gaji, upah, komisen

back.en: Same each month: rent, loans, insurance, savings
back.bm: Sama setiap bulan: sewa, pinjaman, insurans, simpanan

back.en: Change monthly: food, petrol, utilities, entertainment
back.bm: Berubah setiap bulan: makanan, petrol, utiliti, hiburan

back.en: Save at least 10% of income before spending
Cut variable expenses, increase income, or extend the goal's time
back.bm: Kurangkan perbelanjaan tidak tetap, tambah pendapatan, atau lanjutkan tempoh matlamat

back.en: Needs: essential (food, shelter, transport to school). Wants: nice to have (latest phone, branded shoes)
back.bm: Keperluan: penting (makanan, tempat tinggal, pengangkutan ke sekolah). Kehendak: bagus jika ada (telefon terkini, kasut berjenama)

back.en: Savings for unexpected costs — usually 3 to 6 months of expenses
back.bm: Simpanan untuk kos yang tidak dijangka — biasanya perbelanjaan 3 hingga 6 bulan

back.en: Gross income minus deductions such as EPF (KWSP), SOCSO (PERKESO) and income tax
back.bm: Pendapatan kasar tolak potongan seperti KWSP, PERKESO dan cukai pendapatan

front.en: Saving for a goal of RM1,200 in a year
front.bm: Menyimpan untuk matlamat RM1,200 dalam setahun

back.en: Cash flow = −RM200 → a deficit; cut variable expenses or raise income
back.bm: Aliran tunai = −RM200 → defisit; kurangkan perbelanjaan tidak tetap atau tambah pendapatan
